description: 简单直齿圆柱齿轮（近似外形）
code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
module = 2          # 模数 (mm)
num_teeth = 20      # 齿数
pressure_angle = 20 # 压力角 (度)
face_width = 10     # 齿宽 (mm)
bore_d = 8          # 轴孔直径 (mm)

# === 计算 ===
pitch_r = module * num_teeth / 2
addendum = module
dedendum = 1.25 * module
outer_r = pitch_r + addendum
root_r = pitch_r - dedendum
tooth_angle = 360 / num_teeth

# === 建模 ===
# 齿根圆盘
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(root_r)
    .extrude(face_width)
)

# 齿形（用梯形近似每个齿）
for i in range(num_teeth):
    angle = math.radians(i * tooth_angle)
    half_tooth = math.radians(tooth_angle * 0.22)
    pts = [
        (root_r * math.cos(angle - half_tooth), root_r * math.sin(angle - half_tooth)),
        (outer_r * math.cos(angle - half_tooth * 0.6), outer_r * math.sin(angle - half_tooth * 0.6)),
        (outer_r * math.cos(angle + half_tooth * 0.6), outer_r * math.sin(angle + half_tooth * 0.6)),
        (root_r * math.cos(angle + half_tooth), root_r * math.sin(angle + half_tooth)),
    ]
    tooth = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .polyline(pts).close()
        .extrude(face_width)
    )
    result = result.union(tooth)

# 轴孔
result = result.faces(">Z").workplane().hole(bore_d)

show_object(result)
